triples.evidence_text: The recognized standard for this test is ISO 6296:2000 Petroleum products – Determination of water – Potentiometric Karl Fischer titration method.

triples.head_surface: moisture in a lubrication or hydraulic oil sample
triples.head_canonical_zh: 润滑油或液压油中的水分
triples.evidence_text: The Karl Fischer titration test measures moisture in a lubrication or hydraulic oil sample, which is an indicator of a degraded oil condition

triples.tail_surface: deterioration of properties such as the dielectric breakdown voltage
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 介电击穿电压等性能恶化
triples.evidence_text: A high water content may make a dielectric insulating liquid unsuitable for some electrical applications due to deterioration of properties such as the dielectric breakdown voltage.

triples.evidence_text: The kinematic viscosity test provides an indication of oil deterioration over time or contamination of the oil by fuel or other oils.
